talk: ^Rie! It's a pleasure to meet you Rie!
^Sorry I’m late! What a delay, huh?
^Detective, you’re not from around here are you?
^Sorry, no. I'm not from around here.
^That explains it. Any local would know how to work around the VTS.
^The VTS always has something going on. If it actually managed to get you where you were going by the posted time it’d be nothing short of a miracle.
^An hour’s a bit much, even for it.
^*Observation added to Detective Notebook: Routine Delays.*

^Whenever something that might be important to the case comes up, the detective will make a memo in the Detective’s Notebook. Remember to check it! An observation might not seem helpful at the moment, but who knows when it can come around to crack the case!
^I’m sure a detective like yourself is busy enough without having to listen to me complain about the old VTS.
^I was hoping you would have had the work for me.
^*Observation added to Detective Notebook: Incompetent Management.*
^Right, okay. Did someone you know give you that order?
^She should be at Outpost 6, which just so happens to be on the opposite side of town
